threads.body: [General] Move this entry to `⚠️ Breaking changes to non-stable APIs` at CHANGELOG.md:294. `ProcessResource` belongs to the alpha resources library, so placing its removal under general breaking changes obscures the stable/non-stable API distinction required by `.github/copilot-instructions.md:35–36`. Keep the migration guidance when moving it.

@@ -14,6 +14,8 @@
   `otel.javaagent.add-thread-details=true` to capture `thread.id` and `thread.name` on spans.
 - GenAI message events from AWS Bedrock Runtime and OpenAI leave the body unset when no fields
   remain, instead of emitting an empty object.

replies.body:
Addressed in f8191fbf45fc97b3c4eab5c9d5d35f21044d6189.

The resources library is a published alpha artifact: its module does not set otel.stable=true, and version.gradle.kts assigns the alpha version by default. The repository API policy assigns such removals to breaking changes to non-stable APIs. Candidate commit 1 moves the unchanged ProcessResource.get() removal entry into that section while preserving both factory migration alternatives.
